Bea (People Ops): Quick note — Mina K. starts Mon remote. Passport is unexpired but only has 29 days left and background portal flagged a last-name punctuation mismatch. Need an I-9 path + laptop plan.
Carlos (Hiring Ops): If passport is unexpired on start date it's OK for I-9, but name mismatch needs either name-change doc or affidavit. Mina, can you upload any marriage/court docs or a short affidavit?
Mina K. (new hire): Hi! I have a scanned name-affidavit from last year and a utility bill. Uploading both now. Courier for laptop is preferred.
Backgrounds: Got the affidavit and utility bill. Manual review queued; ETA ~3 hours. If affidavit links to passport we can soft-clear.
IT-ShipBot: For laptop shipping please confirm address. Sample command we use: ```create_label --to "Mina K." --addr "101 Market St Apt 6B, San Francisco, CA 94105" --carrier UPS --service 2Day --signature_required``` We'll image with limited access until i-9 cleared.
Mina K. (new hire): Use home address above. Signature required please.
Bea (People Ops): BadgeBot can create a 48h pickup pass as backup. @BadgeBot please create and send QR once manifest is ready.
BadgeBot: Pickup pass created for mina.k@redwood.com — valid 48h from delivery ETA — QR emailed.
Backgrounds: Manual check complete; name tokens reconciled with affidavit. Background = soft-cleared. I-9 still needs Section 2 verification (virtual notary accepted in CA).
Carlos (Hiring Ops): Great. Mina, schedule a virtual notary for Section 2 today if possible; otherwise we'll accept an authorized representative form.
Mina K. (new hire): Scheduled virtual notary for 3pm PT today. Will upload signed Section 2 immediately after.
Bea (People Ops): Action items: Mina to upload notarized Section 2 (in progress), IT to ship laptop with limited access (queued), Backgrounds soft-clear done, People Ops to flip final clearance once Section 2 is in. I'll update tracker when done. :white_check_mark:
